001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.lang.System.Logger.Level;
004import java.lang.ref.WeakReference;
005import java.time.Instant;
006import java.util.ArrayList;
007import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.Set;
010import java.util.stream.Collectors;

012import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
013
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor.Source;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.CaseChanging;
017
018/**
019 * A dynamic version of {@link LogEvent}'s static "<code>of</code>" factory methods - same
020 * method shapes (level, message, ...), but {@link #timestamp()}, {@link #threadName()},
021 * {@link #threadId()} and {@link #loggerName()} are resolved through overridable methods
022 * instead of being passed in on every call/pulled from
023 * {@link Instant#now()}/{@link Thread#currentThread()} inline the way those static
024 * methods do. Those static methods are unaffected for now; this is a first step toward
025 * eventually replacing them.
026 * <p>
027 * Not being able to override thread name/thread id/timestamp is a real limitation for
028 * anything that needs deterministic events not tied to whichever real thread happens to
029 * construct them - tests especially, but possibly other reasons later. A test-specific
030 * implementation overriding those methods once gets an entire family of
031 * event-construction methods that are deterministic, rather than needing to thread fixed
032 * values through every call site.
033 * <p>
034 * Each arity of message argument has its own, distinctly-named method
035 * ({@link #eventNoArg(Level, String, KeyValues, Throwable) eventNoArg}/
036 * {@link #eventOneArg(Level, String, KeyValues, Object) eventOneArg}/
037 * {@link #eventTwoArg(Level, String, KeyValues, Object, Object) eventTwoArg}/
038 * {@link #eventArgs(Level, String, KeyValues, Object[], Throwable) eventArgs}) rather
039 * than being overloaded under one name and disambiguated only by parameter shape - this
040 * is meant to be the one place any facade implementation (SLF4J, JCL, JUL, ...) goes to
041 * build events correctly, and overload resolution across five-plus differently-shaped
042 * methods sharing a name reads confusingly at call sites once there are this many of
043 * them.
044 * <p>
045 * This holds no mutable per-instance state - implementations are expected to be immutable
046 * too. Implement it (or extend {@link #of(String)}'s returned instance's behavior by
047 * writing your own implementation) and override individual methods to customize how
048 * events get constructed.
049 *
050 * @apiNote a builder that in turn builds/configures a factory was considered but is not
051 * included (yet) - implementing this directly covers today's need (mainly tests and
052 * facade modules) with less machinery.
053 */
054public interface LogEventFactory {
055
056        /**
057         * Creates a factory bound to the given logger name, otherwise using default behavior
058         * for {@link #timestamp()}, {@link #threadName()}, {@link #threadId()} and
059         * {@link #messageFormatter()}.
060         * @param loggerName logger name every event created by the returned factory will
061         * have.
062         * @return factory.
063         */
064        public static LogEventFactory of(String loggerName) {
065                return new DefaultLogEventFactory(loggerName);
066        }
067
068        /**
069         * Name of the logger every event created by this factory will have.
070         * @return logger name.
071         */
072        String loggerName();
073
074        /**
075         * Timestamp to use for the next event created by this factory. Default is
076         * {@link Instant#now()}.
077         * @return timestamp.
078         */
079        default Instant timestamp() {
080                return Instant.now();
081        }
082
083        /**
084         * Thread name to use for the next event created by this factory. Default is
085         * {@link Thread#getName() Thread.currentThread().getName()}.
086         * @return thread name.
087         * @apiNote this maybe empty and often is if virtual threads are used.
088         */
089        default String threadName() {
090                return Thread.currentThread().getName();
091        }
092
093        /**
094         * Thread id to use for the next event created by this factory. Default is
095         * {@link Thread#threadId() Thread.currentThread().threadId()}.
096         * @return thread id.
097         */
098        default long threadId() {
099                return Thread.currentThread().threadId();
100        }
101
102        /**
103         * Key values to use for the next event created by this factory when a caller does not
104         * supply an explicit {@link KeyValues}. Default is every {@link KeyValuesContributor}
105         * registered with the currently bound {@link RainbowGum} merged together (see
106         * {@link KeyValuesContributor#global(KeyValuesContributor.Source...)}), which is
107         * empty if none are registered or no Rainbow Gum is bound.
108         * @return key values.
109         */
110        default KeyValues defaultKeyValues() {
111                return KeyValuesContributors.GLOBAL.keyValues();
112        }
113
114        /**
115         * Formatter to use for rendering a message when
116         * {@link LogEvent#formattedMessage(StringBuilder)} is called on events created by
117         * this factory that take arguments. Default is
118         * {@link LogMessageFormatter.StandardMessageFormatter#SLF4J}.
119         * @return message formatter.
120         * @apiNote a method rather than a parameter on the {@code eventXxx} methods below
121         * since this rarely changes per event - override it instead if a different formatter
122         * is needed.
123         */
124        default LogMessageFormatter messageFormatter() {
125                return LogMessageFormatter.StandardMessageFormatter.SLF4J;
126        }
127
128        /**
129         * Creates a log event whose message is already formatted (no arguments). Corresponds
130         * to
131         * {@link LogEvent#of(Instant, String, long, Level, String, String, KeyValues, Throwable)}.
132         * @param level the logging level.
133         * @param formattedMessage the unformatted message.
134         * @param keyValues key values that come from MDC or an SLF4J Event Builder.
135         * @param throwable an exception if passed maybe <code>null</code>.
136         * @return event.
137         * @apiNote the message is already assumed to be formatted as no arguments are passed.
138         */
139        default LogEvent eventNoArg(Level level, @Nullable String formattedMessage, KeyValues keyValues,
140                        @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
141                return LogEvent.of(timestamp(), threadName(), threadId(), level, loggerName(), formattedMessage, keyValues,
142                                throwable);
143        }
144
145        /**
146         * Like {@link #eventNoArg(Level, String, KeyValues, Throwable)} but using
147         * {@link #defaultKeyValues()}.
148         * @param level the logging level.
149         * @param formattedMessage the unformatted message.
150         * @param throwable an exception if passed maybe <code>null</code>.
151         * @return event.
152         */
153        default LogEvent eventNoArg(Level level, @Nullable String formattedMessage, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
154                return eventNoArg(level, formattedMessage, defaultKeyValues(), throwable);
155        }
156
157        /**
158         * Creates a log event with a single message argument. Corresponds to
159         * {@link LogEvent#ofOneArg(Instant, String, long, Level, String, String, KeyValues, LogMessageFormatter, Object)}.
160         * @param level the logging level.
161         * @param message the unformatted message.
162         * @param keyValues key values that come from MDC or an SLF4J Event Builder.
163         * @param arg1 argument that will be passed to {@link #messageFormatter()}.
164         * @return event.
165         */
166        default LogEvent eventOneArg(Level level, @Nullable String message, KeyValues keyValues, @Nullable Object arg1) {
167                Instant timestamp = timestamp();
168                String threadName = threadName();
169                long threadId = threadId();
170                String loggerName = loggerName();
171                var messageFormatter = messageFormatter();
172                return LogEvent.ofOneArg(timestamp, threadName, threadId, level, loggerName, message, keyValues,
173                                messageFormatter, arg1);
174        }
175
176        /**
177         * Like {@link #eventOneArg(Level, String, KeyValues, Object)} but using
178         * {@link #defaultKeyValues()}.
179         * @param level the logging level.
180         * @param message the unformatted message.
181         * @param arg1 argument that will be passed to {@link #messageFormatter()}.
182         * @return event.
183         */
184        default LogEvent eventOneArg(Level level, @Nullable String message, @Nullable Object arg1) {
185                return eventOneArg(level, message, defaultKeyValues(), arg1);
186        }
187
188        /**
189         * Creates a log event with two message arguments. Corresponds to
190         * {@link LogEvent#ofTwoArgs(Instant, String, long, Level, String, String, KeyValues, LogMessageFormatter, Object, Object)}.
191         * @param level the logging level.
192         * @param message the unformatted message.
193         * @param keyValues key values that come from MDC or an SLF4J Event Builder.
194         * @param arg1 argument that will be passed to {@link #messageFormatter()}.
195         * @param arg2 argument that will be passed to {@link #messageFormatter()}.
196         * @return event.
197         */
198        default LogEvent eventTwoArg(Level level, @Nullable String message, KeyValues keyValues, @Nullable Object arg1,
199                        @Nullable Object arg2) {
200                Instant timestamp = timestamp();
201                String threadName = threadName();
202                long threadId = threadId();
203                String loggerName = loggerName();
204                var messageFormatter = messageFormatter();
205                return LogEvent.ofTwoArgs(timestamp, threadName, threadId, level, loggerName, message, keyValues,
206                                messageFormatter, arg1, arg2);
207        }
208
209        /**
210         * Like {@link #eventTwoArg(Level, String, KeyValues, Object, Object)} but using
211         * {@link #defaultKeyValues()}.
212         * @param level the logging level.
213         * @param message the unformatted message.
214         * @param arg1 argument that will be passed to {@link #messageFormatter()}.
215         * @param arg2 argument that will be passed to {@link #messageFormatter()}.
216         * @return event.
217         */
218        default LogEvent eventTwoArg(Level level, @Nullable String message, @Nullable Object arg1, @Nullable Object arg2) {
219                return eventTwoArg(level, message, defaultKeyValues(), arg1, arg2);
220        }
221
222        /**
223         * Creates a log event with an array of message arguments. Corresponds to
224         * {@link LogEvent#ofAll(Instant, String, long, Level, String, String, KeyValues, Throwable, LogMessageFormatter, Object[])}.
225         * @param level the logging level.
226         * @param message the unformatted message.
227         * @param keyValues key values that come from MDC or an SLF4J Event Builder.
228         * @param args an array of arguments that will be passed to
229         * {@link #messageFormatter()}. The contents maybe null elements but the array itself
230         * should not be null.
231         * @param throwable an exception if passed maybe <code>null</code>.
232         * @return event.
233         */
234        default LogEvent eventArgs(Level level, @Nullable String message, KeyValues keyValues,
235                        @SuppressWarnings("exports") @Nullable Object @Nullable [] args, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
236                return LogEvent.ofAll(timestamp(), threadName(), threadId(), level, loggerName(), message, keyValues, throwable,
237                                messageFormatter(), args);
238        }
239
240        /**
241         * Like {@link #eventArgs(Level, String, KeyValues, Object[], Throwable)} with no
242         * throwable.
243         * @param level the logging level.
244         * @param message the unformatted message.
245         * @param keyValues key values that come from MDC or an SLF4J Event Builder.
246         * @param args an array of arguments that will be passed to
247         * {@link #messageFormatter()}.
248         * @return event.
249         */
250        default LogEvent eventArgs(Level level, @Nullable String message, KeyValues keyValues,
251                        @SuppressWarnings("exports") @Nullable Object @Nullable [] args) {
252                return eventArgs(level, message, keyValues, args, null);
253        }
254
255        /**
256         * Like {@link #eventArgs(Level, String, KeyValues, Object[], Throwable)} but using
257         * {@link #defaultKeyValues()}.
258         * @param level the logging level.
259         * @param message the unformatted message.
260         * @param args an array of arguments that will be passed to
261         * {@link #messageFormatter()}.
262         * @param throwable an exception if passed maybe <code>null</code>.
263         * @return event.
264         */
265        default LogEvent eventArgs(Level level, @Nullable String message,
266                        @SuppressWarnings("exports") @Nullable Object @Nullable [] args, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
267                return eventArgs(level, message, defaultKeyValues(), args, throwable);
268        }
269
270        /**
271         * Like {@link #eventArgs(Level, String, KeyValues, Object[], Throwable)} but using
272         * {@link #defaultKeyValues()} and no throwable.
273         * @param level the logging level.
274         * @param message the unformatted message.
275         * @param args an array of arguments that will be passed to
276         * {@link #messageFormatter()}.
277         * @return event.
278         */
279        default LogEvent eventArgs(Level level, @Nullable String message,
280                        @SuppressWarnings("exports") @Nullable Object @Nullable [] args) {
281                return eventArgs(level, message, defaultKeyValues(), args, null);
282        }
283
284        /**
285         * A source of ambient key values (MDC like context) for events whose logging API has
286         * no context of its own, such as JUL or {@link System.Logger}. Each supported store
287         * of ambient key values registers one with
288         * {@link #register(ServiceRegistry, Source, KeyValuesContributor)}, usually from a
289         * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator}.
290         * <p>
291         * Only the stores listed in {@link Source.Standard} can contribute. When more than
292         * one is registered they are merged in the declaration order of
293         * {@link Source.Standard}, so on a key collision the later constant wins. A logging
294         * facade that has its own context store excludes its own {@link Source} when
295         * resolving the rest and passes its own key values to {@link #keyValues(KeyValues)},
296         * which places them above every other source except {@link Source.Standard#USER}.
297         *
298         * <p>
299         * {@link #clear()} clears the current thread's context in every selected store and in
300         * the stores not selected whose {@link Source.Standard#clearWhenUnselected()} policy
301         * permits it, for example when a pooled thread finishes a task:
302         * {@snippet :
303         * KeyValuesContributor.global().clear();
304         * }
305         * Appender buffers kept per thread are cleared separately with
306         * {@link LogAppender#clearThreadLocals()}.
307         *
308         * @apiNote Rainbow Gum core deliberately has no API for putting key values into a
309         * context. Contributors only expose (and clear) whatever context store the
310         * application already uses.
311         */
312        @FunctionalInterface
313        public interface KeyValuesContributor {
314
315                /**
316                 * Key values for an event being created on the current thread. Called once per
317                 * event on the logging thread so it should be cheap. It must not throw or log and
318                 * should return {@link KeyValues#of()} when there is nothing to contribute. The
319                 * returned key values may be live (not a copy) as long as they are not modified
320                 * while the event is being created.
321                 * @return key values, never {@code null}.
322                 */
323                KeyValues keyValues();
324
325                /**
326                 * Like {@link #keyValues()} but with a logging facade's own key values merged in
327                 * above every contributor except {@link Source.Standard#USER}, which still wins.
328                 * @param own the calling facade's own context, for example its MDC.
329                 * @return merged key values, which is {@code own} itself when nothing else
330                 * contributes.
331                 */
332                default KeyValues keyValues(KeyValues own) {
333                        return KeyValues.merge(keyValues(), own);
334                }
335
336                /**
337                 * Clears all of the current thread's state in the underlying context store,
338                 * including state that is not exposed as key values such as a nested diagnostic
339                 * context (NDC) stack, so a pooled thread starts its next task with no context
340                 * left over. A store that cannot be cleared this way, such as one bound to a
341                 * scope, does nothing. Like {@link #keyValues()} it must not throw or log. The
342                 * default does nothing.
343                 * @see LogAppender#clearThreadLocals()
344                 */
345                default void clear() {
346                }
347
348                /**
349                 * Identifies a context store that contributes key values.
350                 *
351                 * @apiNote sealed so that contributions come only from known stores: an unknown
352                 * third party contributor could silently change or break the key values of every
353                 * event.
354                 */
355                public sealed interface Source permits Source.Standard {
356
357                        /**
358                         * The context stores Rainbow Gum supports, in merge order: a later constant
359                         * wins over an earlier one on a key collision.
360                         */
361                        @CaseChanging
362                        enum Standard implements Source {
363
364                                /**
365                                 * Key values added to every event, such as a build version or instance
366                                 * id, which every other source overrides on a key collision. Like
367                                 * {@link #USER} it belongs to the application;
368                                 * {@code rainbowgum-keyvalues-contributor} provides one configured by
369                                 * properties.
370                                 */
371                                DEFAULTS(false),
372                                /**
373                                 * {@code rainbowgum-opentelemetry}: the trace and span id of the current
374                                 * OpenTelemetry span. Not cleared: the OpenTelemetry context belongs to
375                                 * the application, not to Rainbow Gum.
376                                 */
377                                OPENTELEMETRY(false),
378                                /**
379                                 * {@code rainbowgum-scopedkeyvalues} ({@code ScopedKeyValues}).
380                                 */
381                                SCOPED_KEY_VALUES(false),
382                                /**
383                                 * {@code rainbowgum-jboss-logging} ({@code org.jboss.logging.MDC}).
384                                 */
385                                JBOSS_LOGGING(true),
386                                /**
387                                 * {@code rainbowgum-log4j2}
388                                 * ({@code org.apache.logging.log4j.ThreadContext}).
389                                 */
390                                LOG4J2(true),
391                                /**
392                                 * {@code rainbowgum-slf4j} ({@code org.slf4j.MDC}).
393                                 */
394                                SLF4J(true),
395                                /**
396                                 * The application's own contributor, which wins over every other source
397                                 * including a logging facade's own context store. Only for applications:
398                                 * a library must not register a {@code USER} contributor, since there is
399                                 * only one per Rainbow Gum and the application decides what it is.
400                                 */
401                                USER(false);
402
403                                private final boolean clearWhenUnselected;
404
405                                Standard(boolean clearWhenUnselected) {
406                                        this.clearWhenUnselected = clearWhenUnselected;
407                                }
408
409                                /**
410                                 * Whether this source's contributor is still cleared when the source is
411                                 * not selected with {@value LogProperties#KEY_VALUES_SOURCES_PROPERTY}.
412                                 * Logging facades always use their own context stores for their own
413                                 * events, so those stores are still cleared. Application callbacks and
414                                 * stores with no clearable thread state are not invoked when not
415                                 * selected.
416                                 * @return whether to clear the contributor when not selected.
417                                 */
418                                public boolean clearWhenUnselected() {
419                                        return clearWhenUnselected;
420                                }
421
422                        }
423
424                }
425
426                /**
427                 * Registers the contributor for a context store. A store that is already
428                 * registered is not replaced.
429                 * @param registry usually {@link LogConfig#serviceRegistry()}.
430                 * @param source which context store the contributor exposes.
431                 * @param contributor the contributor.
432                 */
433                public static void register(ServiceRegistry registry, Source source, KeyValuesContributor contributor) {
434                        registry.put(KeyValuesContributor.class, KeyValuesContributors.registryName(source), contributor);
435                }
436
437                /**
438                 * Combines the contributors currently registered in a service registry, skipping
439                 * the excluded sources and those not selected with
440                 * {@value LogProperties#KEY_VALUES_SOURCES_PROPERTY}. The registry is read once
441                 * on this call, so contributors registered afterward are not included.
442                 * @param registry where contributors are registered.
443                 * @param excluded sources to skip, usually the caller's own.
444                 * @return combined contributor, which returns {@link KeyValues#of()} if nothing
445                 * is registered.
446                 */
447                public static KeyValuesContributor of(ServiceRegistry registry, Source... excluded) {
448                        return KeyValuesContributors.of(registry, Set.of(excluded));
449                }
450
451                /**
452                 * Combines the contributors registered with whichever {@link RainbowGum} is bound
453                 * globally at the time key values are requested, skipping the excluded sources.
454                 * Meant for logging facades that route through {@link LogRouter#global()} and so
455                 * cannot hold a reference to a particular Rainbow Gum.
456                 * @param excluded sources to skip, usually the caller's own.
457                 * @return contributor that follows the globally bound Rainbow Gum and returns
458                 * {@link KeyValues#of()} while none is bound.
459                 */
460                public static KeyValuesContributor global(Source... excluded) {
461                        if (excluded.length == 0) {
462                                return KeyValuesContributors.GLOBAL;
463                        }
464                        return new KeyValuesContributors.Global(Set.of(excluded));
465                }
466
467        }
468
469}
470
471record DefaultLogEventFactory(String loggerName) implements LogEventFactory {
472}
473
474final class KeyValuesContributors {
475
476        static final Global GLOBAL = new Global(Set.of());
477
478        private KeyValuesContributors() {
479        }
480
481        static String registryName(Source source) {
482                return switch (source) {
483                        case Source.Standard s -> s.name();
484                };
485        }
486
487        /*
488         * The sources selected by property, parsed and validated when the config is built and
489         * kept in its service registry so that combining contributors needs only the
490         * registry. Without one in the registry every source is selected.
491         */
492        record Selected(Set<Source> sources) {
493
494                static Set<Source> parse(List<String> names) {
495                        var sources = new LinkedHashSet<Source>();
496                        for (String name : names) {
497                                sources.add(LogProperty.enumValue(Source.Standard.class, name));
498                        }
499                        return Set.copyOf(sources);
500                }
501
502        }
503
504        static KeyValuesContributor of(ServiceRegistry registry, Set<Source> excluded) {
505                var below = new ArrayList<KeyValuesContributor>();
506                var clearable = new ArrayList<KeyValuesContributor>();
507                KeyValuesContributor user = null;
508                var selected = registry.findOrNull(Selected.class);
509                for (var source : Source.Standard.values()) {
510                        if (excluded.contains(source)) {
511                                continue;
512                        }
513                        var c = registry.findOrNull(KeyValuesContributor.class, registryName(source));
514                        if (c == null) {
515                                continue;
516                        }
517                        boolean isSelected = selected == null || selected.sources().contains(source);
518                        if (isSelected || source.clearWhenUnselected()) {
519                                clearable.add(c);
520                        }
521                        if (!isSelected) {
522                                continue;
523                        }
524                        if (source == Source.Standard.USER) {
525                                user = c;
526                        }
527                        else {
528                                below.add(c);
529                        }
530                }
531                if (below.isEmpty() && user == null && clearable.isEmpty()) {
532                        return Empty.INSTANCE;
533                }
534                return new Composite(below.toArray(new KeyValuesContributor[0]), user,
535                                clearable.toArray(new KeyValuesContributor[0]));
536        }
537
538        enum Empty implements KeyValuesContributor {
539
540                INSTANCE;
541
542                @Override
543                public KeyValues keyValues() {
544                        return KeyValues.of();
545                }
546
547                @Override
548                public KeyValues keyValues(KeyValues own) {
549                        return own;
550                }
551
552        }
553
554        /*
555         * Merge order, lowest first: the non USER contributors in Source.Standard order, the
556         * caller's own key values, then USER.
557         */
558        static final class Composite implements KeyValuesContributor {
559
560                private final KeyValuesContributor[] below;
561
562                private final @Nullable KeyValuesContributor user;
563
564                private final KeyValuesContributor[] clearable;
565
566                Composite(KeyValuesContributor[] below, @Nullable KeyValuesContributor user, KeyValuesContributor[] clearable) {
567                        this.below = below;
568                        this.user = user;
569                        this.clearable = clearable;
570                }
571
572                @Override
573                public KeyValues keyValues() {
574                        return keyValues(KeyValues.of());
575                }
576
577                @Override
578                public KeyValues keyValues(KeyValues own) {
579                        KeyValues result = KeyValues.of();
580                        for (var c : below) {
581                                result = KeyValues.merge(result, c.keyValues());
582                        }
583                        result = KeyValues.merge(result, own);
584                        var u = user;
585                        if (u != null) {
586                                result = KeyValues.merge(result, u.keyValues());
587                        }
588                        return result;
589                }
590
591                @Override
592                public void clear() {
593                        for (var c : clearable) {
594                                c.clear();
595                        }
596                }
597
598        }
599
600        /*
601         * Resolves the registered contributors once per bound gum instead of per event. The
602         * registry is complete by the time a gum is bound since configurators run before.
603         */
604        static final class Global implements KeyValuesContributor {
605
606                private record Resolved(RainbowGum gum, KeyValuesContributor contributor) {
607                }
608
609                private final Set<Source> excluded;
610
611                private final String registryName;
612
613                private volatile WeakReference<Resolved> resolved = new WeakReference<>(null);
614
615                Global(Set<Source> excluded) {
616                        this.excluded = excluded;
617                        this.registryName = excluded.stream()
618                                .map(KeyValuesContributors::registryName)
619                                .sorted()
620                                .collect(Collectors.joining(","));
621                }
622
623                @Override
624                public KeyValues keyValues() {
625                        return contributor().keyValues();
626                }
627
628                @Override
629                public KeyValues keyValues(KeyValues own) {
630                        return contributor().keyValues(own);
631                }
632
633                @Override
634                public void clear() {
635                        contributor().clear();
636                }
637
638                @SuppressWarnings("ReferenceEquality") // identity of the bound gum is the point
639                private KeyValuesContributor contributor() {
640                        var gum = RainbowGumHolder.peek();
641                        if (gum == null) {
642                                return Empty.INSTANCE;
643                        }
644                        var r = resolved.get();
645                        if (r == null || r.gum() != gum) {
646                                var registry = gum.config().serviceRegistry();
647                                /*
648                                 * The gum owns the strong reference, so an idle global contributor cannot
649                                 * retain a closed gum or its context stores. While bound, the weak cache
650                                 * stays live and avoids a registry lookup on every event.
651                                 */
652                                r = registry.putIfAbsent(Resolved.class, registryName, () -> new Resolved(gum, of(registry, excluded)));
653                                resolved = new WeakReference<>(r);
654                        }
655                        return r.contributor();
656                }
